title: MY Agent service orchestration schema
description: Portable, schema-driven contract for start-services.ps1. Ported from the CQR_PA service-terminal-orchestration WORK_SPEC as a generic skeleton: no machine-specific paths, ports, or service names are baked in.

terminalWindowName.description: Dedicated Windows Terminal window name that collects every service tab. Default MY_AGENT_SERVICES.

name.description: Logical service id used in health/skip reporting.

tabTitle.description: Windows Terminal tab title. Defaults to name.

healthUrl.description: Optional HTTP(S) health probe. If it responds (2xx-4xx), the service is treated as already running and is not launched, restarted, or killed.

skipIfHealthy.description: Set false to always launch even if healthUrl responds.

command.description: Command string executed inside the tab shell (pwsh preferred, powershell fallback).

workingDirectory.description: Optional starting directory for the tab.
